mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, plan_name, prep_duration_months, base_level, target_score, current_stage, start_date, exam_date, daily_target_hours, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM user_study_plan WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_study_plan (user_id, plan_name, prep_duration_months, base_level, target_score, current_stage, start_date, exam_date, daily_target_hours, is_active) VALUES (#{userId}, #{planName}, #{prepDurationMonths}, #{baseLevel}, #{targetScore}, #{currentStage}, #{startDate}, #{examDate}, #{dailyTargetHours}, #{isActive})
mapper.select: SELECT id, plan_id, week_number, stage, subject_code, title, task_type, target_chapter_id, is_completed, completed_at, description, target_route, target_count, progress_current, progress_unit, auto_rule, baseline_value, due_date, priority, is_auto, last_synced_at FROM user_study_plan_task WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY week_number ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_study_plan_task (plan_id, week_number, stage, subject_code, title, task_type, target_chapter_id, is_completed, completed_at, description, target_route, target_count, progress_current, progress_unit, auto_rule, baseline_value, due_date, priority, is_auto, last_synced_at) VALUES (#{planId}, #{weekNumber}, #{stage}, #{subjectCode}, #{title}, #{taskType}, #{targetChapterId}, #{isCompleted}, #{completedAt}, #{description}, #{targetRoute}, #{targetCount}, #{progressCurrent}, #{progressUnit}, #{autoRule}, #{baselineValue}, #{dueDate}, #{priority}, #{isAuto}, #{lastSyncedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_study_plan_task SET is_completed = #{isCompleted}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{isCompleted} = 1 THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{taskId}

UPDATE user_study_plan_task SET progress_current = #{progressCurrent}, is_completed = #{isCompleted}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{isCompleted} = 1 AND completed_at IS NULL THEN NOW() WHEN #{isCompleted} = 0 THEN NULL ELSE completed_at END, last_synced_at = #{lastSyncedAt} WHERE id = #{taskId}
UPDATE user_study_plan SET is_active = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = 1
